flows.title: 1 · Customer orders → request reaches drivers
flows.summary: The 4-step wizard creates the order in stage searching. A paired driver is offered first; otherwise eligible online drivers are offered one at a time, each with a response window.

flows.title: 2 · Driver accepts → everyone tracks the delivery
flows.summary: Accepting assigns the order and withdraws other open offers. All three apps follow the same order record.

steps.label: stage → assigned · dispatch accepted · others withdrawn

flows.title: 3 · Driver declines → record stays, next driver offered
flows.summary: The declined record and reason remain in the driver’s request history and the admin Driver requests tab. The customer keeps waiting.

steps.label: dispatch → declined · offer next eligible driver

flows.title: 4 · Driver misses the request → timeout
flows.summary: When the window passes without an answer, the next server tick marks the offer missed, notifies the driver and offers the order to the next driver.

flows.title: 5 · Multi-stop delivery with PIN handover
flows.summary: Each driver tap advances one stage; each stop is handed over with the recipient’s PIN or a confirmation. Apps converge within one poll (customer 2 s, admin 4 s).

flows.title: 6 · Payment after handover
flows.summary: Delivery creates a payment attempt. Uncertain results are checked before retrying. The payer can be the customer or the stop-1 recipient.

flows.title: 7 · Cash collection & remittance
flows.summary: For cash orders the driver records cash received, the payer confirms it, and finance records the platform-fee remittance. The driver’s retained earning is never paid twice.

flows.title: 8 · Driver releases an accepted delivery
flows.summary: Before loading, a driver can back out. The order returns to searching instead of being cancelled.

flows.title: 9 · Customer cancels
flows.summary: Allowed until cargo is collected. Open offers are withdrawn so drivers see why the request disappeared.

flows.title: 10 · Delivery messages
flows.summary: After acceptance, customer and driver exchange messages and quick replies on the order.

flows.title: 11 · Driver onboarding & approval
flows.summary: Drivers submit vehicle and four documents; staff review and approve, then the driver can go online.

flows.title: 12 · Operations reassigns a driver
flows.summary: Staff with trip access can assign any verified online driver with a suitable truck before cargo is collected.

flows.title: 13 · Driver payout request
flows.summary: Drivers request all scheduled earnings; finance approves and pays every included trip, or rejects with a reason.

flows.title: 14 · Live tracking across all three apps
flows.summary: Each driver stage update moves the truck on the customer map, the admin fleet map and the admin trip page within one poll (customer 2 s, admin 4 s). Positions are simulated from the stage.

flows.title: 15 · Operations manage a driver account
flows.summary: From the driver page, staff with “Edit, suspend and deactivate accounts” can set a driver offline, revoke verification, suspend, deactivate or reset a password. Each needs a reason and is audited.

steps.label: Open offers withdrawn · sessions revoked · audit

flows.title: 16 · Super Admin edits a role
flows.summary: Roles are records with permissions. Editing one changes what everyone in it can see and do on their next request; sections they lose are not rendered at all.

machines.title: Driver request (dispatch) outcomes
transitions: taken by another / cancelled / driver offline

sync: All three apps read one shared order record from the demo service.
Customer & Driver apps poll GET /snapshot every 2 s and on app foreground; Admin polls GET /admin every 4 s.
Mutations call refresh() immediately; a refresh requested during a poll is queued, not dropped.
Real-time = within one poll interval. Push/websockets are not implemented.

kids.t: Office approval followed by finance disbursement. Provider payments are simulated.
How to review and pay a withdrawal
Verify the driver's amount and destination, then approve or reject the request.
Finance records the provider result and transfer reference. Approval leaves the money awaiting payment.
For a pending result, check the same transfer before attempting another payment. A confirmed failure can be retried or rejected.
Record the charge and payer. For example, a UGX 10,000 withdrawal with a UGX 500 driver-paid charge delivers UGX 9,500. When LoadMaster covers the charge, the driver receives UGX 10,000.
Use a payouts reconciliation report to compare net transfers and charges with provider records.

kids.t: Choose collections, payouts or refunds and the provider and dates covered by the provider file. Cash and LoadMaster wallet payments are tracked in the ledger.
Compare the provider reference and amount. For payouts, also compare the charge and net amount received.
Open the linked trip or withdrawal to inspect its attempts. Resolve an awaiting confirmation only after verifying the provider evidence.
Import again after a correction to compare the current records. Earlier imports retain their original comparison and any resolution notes.

kids.t: A little help goes a long way.
How do I order a truck?
Choose pickup and destination, select a suitable truck, confirm handling and payment method, then tap Order a truck.
Transport only means you arrange handling. Add helpers at pickup, destination, or both before ordering. Stairs, heavy equipment and complex loads need an assisted quote.
The demo payment starts after delivery is confirmed. Mobile Money and card outcomes are simulated; no real payment is sent.
Check the current payment status. Do not start another payment while the first outcome is uncertain.
Choose the right capacity before setting your route.

Choose an amount and destination. Office reviews your request, then finance sends your payment. The payout record shows the provider charge, who covers it, and the amount you receive. Charges are confirmed by finance. Payments are simulated in this demo.
Enter the amount to remove from your earnings. If you cover a provider charge, it is deducted from this amount.
Requests you accept, decline or miss are kept here.
A good move is worth sharing.

kids.t: Share your code to preview the referral experience. Rewards are recorded and approved by operations, not automatically promised.
Approved referral and cashback records appear here.
Both apps must connect to the same demo service. These are separate synthetic accounts, not production sign-in.
Physical device: your computer’s LAN IP on port 4000.
Use two driver accounts to test competing acceptance. Each customer can have one immediate active order, plus scheduled orders.
Reports you send from Help & support will appear here.
Changing vehicle details requires a new review. Finish any current delivery first.
Submit all four documents, then an administrator reviews them and approves your driver account. Use demo images, not real identity documents.

kids.t: Sign in to your connected cargo experience.
Prototype environment. Use synthetic details; no real payments or identity verification take place.
A little help goes a long way.
How do I order a truck?
Choose pickup and destination, select a suitable truck, confirm handling and payment method, then tap Order a truck.
Transport only means you arrange handling. Add helpers at pickup, destination, or both before ordering. Stairs, heavy equipment and complex loads need an assisted quote.
The demo payment starts after delivery is confirmed. Mobile Money and card outcomes are simulated; no real payment is sent.
Check the current payment status. Do not start another payment while the first outcome is uncertain.
From pickup to delivery, keep every load in sight.

THE WORK YOU DO. THE MONEY YOU EARN.
Earned from completed deliveries. Payout is separate from customer collection.
Demo settlement is managed through the demo service. A production payout cycle has not been set.

Choose an amount and destination. Office reviews your request, then finance sends your payment. The payout record shows the provider charge, who covers it, and the amount you receive. Charges are confirmed by finance. Payments are simulated in this demo.
Enter the amount to remove from your earnings. If you cover a provider charge, it is deducted from this amount.

kids.t: Office approval followed by finance disbursement. Provider payments are simulated.
How to review and pay a withdrawal
Verify the driver's amount and destination, then approve or reject the request.
Finance records the provider result and transfer reference. Approval leaves the money awaiting payment.
For a pending result, check the same transfer before attempting another payment. A confirmed failure can be retried or rejected.
Record the charge and payer. For example, a UGX 10,000 withdrawal with a UGX 500 driver-paid charge delivers UGX 9,500. When LoadMaster covers the charge, the driver receives UGX 10,000.
Use a payouts reconciliation report to compare net transfers and charges with provider records.

kids.t: Office approval followed by finance disbursement. Provider payments are simulated.
How to review and pay a withdrawal
Verify the driver's amount and destination, then approve or reject the request.
Finance records the provider result and transfer reference. Approval leaves the money awaiting payment.
For a pending result, check the same transfer before attempting another payment. A confirmed failure can be retried or rejected.
Record the charge and payer. For example, a UGX 10,000 withdrawal with a UGX 500 driver-paid charge delivers UGX 9,500. When LoadMaster covers the charge, the driver receives UGX 10,000.
Use a payouts reconciliation report to compare net transfers and charges with provider records.

kids.t: Office approval followed by finance disbursement. Provider payments are simulated.
How to review and pay a withdrawal
Verify the driver's amount and destination, then approve or reject the request.
Finance records the provider result and transfer reference. Approval leaves the money awaiting payment.
For a pending result, check the same transfer before attempting another payment. A confirmed failure can be retried or rejected.
Record the charge and payer. For example, a UGX 10,000 withdrawal with a UGX 500 driver-paid charge delivers UGX 9,500. When LoadMaster covers the charge, the driver receives UGX 10,000.
Use a payouts reconciliation report to compare net transfers and charges with provider records.

kids.t: Choose an amount and destination. Office reviews your request, then finance sends your payment. The payout record shows the provider charge, who covers it, and the amount you receive. Charges are confirmed by finance. Payments are simulated in this demo.
. Complete this request before submitting another.
From pickup to delivery, keep every load in sight.

kids.t: Choose collections, payouts or refunds and the provider and dates covered by the provider file. Cash and LoadMaster wallet payments are tracked in the ledger.
Compare the provider reference and amount. For payouts, also compare the charge and net amount received.
Open the linked trip or withdrawal to inspect its attempts. Resolve an awaiting confirmation only after verifying the provider evidence.
Import again after a correction to compare the current records. Earlier imports retain their original comparison and any resolution notes.
